title: hold.opened v1
description: A hold opens. The subject is the hold.

rule_id.description: The rule that caused the hold, where one applies.

credential_id.description: The credential that caused the hold, where one applies. For credential_limit, the candidate that resets first (the wait_limit step's subject), or the credential that stopped when no candidate has a reset time (milestone 3 plan HE-13). For credential_signed_out, the first signed-out candidate in the seat's order (milestone 3 plan HE-12).

rule_check_id.description: The rule check the hold is about, for check_error, claim_gate_failed and rerun_limit; null for every other reason (DB-49). The check held at the re-run limit has no other event until it is let through or withdrawn (milestone 4 plan RD-45), so this is the event the replay makes its row from.
